msContents.summary: This is a paper manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya. The manuscript breaks off at the beginning of the 8th story.

lg.l: yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ rājā bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ

tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syāt tan me brūhi tapo
na 1
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarvve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ

ekato bhayabhītasya prā
ṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇāaṃ 2

prāṇarakṣaṇām eve
ha gauraveṇātiricyate 3
atrevodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ

r auśīnarasya ca 4
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthīaṃ śiviṃ nṛpaṃ

iṃdraḥ syenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā
tatropajagmatuḥ 5
atho bhūmipatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenato bhayāt

śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nililye
bheayavihvalaḥ 6
tataḥ śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ

rājānaṃ sumahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ va
cas tadā 7
dharmātmānaṃ taṃ vadati tvām ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitāṃ

satvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ
thakarma cikīrṣasi 8
bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ

kṣamayā krūrakarmāṇaḥm asārdhu sā
dhunā jayet 9
nopakārapareṣv evam upakāraparo janaḥ
apakārapare pi tvam upakāraparo yathā 10
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpo pi tvam apāpakṛt
doṣānveṣaṇāadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇāatatpataraḥ 11

tad eṣa
vihito bhakṣaḥ pīpramānasya me kṣudhā
mā hiṃsīr lobhato dharma dharmam utsṛṣṭavān asi 12

saṃ
trastrarūpas trāṇārthī tvāatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ
matsakāśam anuprāpto prāṇāagṛdhnurayaṃ khagaḥ 13

tad evam āga
tasyāsya kapotasyābhayārthinaḥ
katham asmadvidhāḥ kuryyāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ 14

lobhād dveṣād bha
yād vāpi yaṃs tyajecharaṇāgataṃ
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur manīṣiṇāaḥ 15

sāstreṣu niṣkatir dṛ
ṣṭā mahāpātakinām api
śaraṇāgatahaṃtur hi na dṛṣṭā niḥkṛtiḥ kvacit 16

yathātmanaḥ priyaḥ prāṇaḥ
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā
evaṃ matvā tu vidvadbhiḥ trātavyāḥ prāṇino bhuvi 17

janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhai
r nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare
jaṃtava parikliśyate mṛtyos trasyaṃti tāparāt 18

yan nimittaṃ bhavechokas trāso
vā krodha eva vā
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekagam api na tyajet 19

mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajā
yate
yuktaṃ tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ 20

yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ
prī
saṃrakṣyare pi parirakṣite jīvitam ātmano | yathā tathā pareṣām api raksi jīvitaṃ 21

tasmān nāham i
maṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotaka
yad atra yuktaṃ manyeta karttu śyenāśu tad vede 22

āhārāt sarvva
bhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti janeśvara
āhāreṇāa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ 23

na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ va
rttayitu kvacit
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāgha praṇā yāsyaṃti me prabho 24

rakṣyamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn praṇā
n na rakṣasi
dharmo yo bādhate dharmān na sa dharma paraṃtapa 25
visṛjya kāḥyaṃ yāsyāmi tmapadātam apunarbhavaṃ
mṛte ca mayi sarvvo me dāraputro mariṣyati 26
avirodhāt tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate

tasmād viro
dhe dharmadharmasya vicityaṃ gurulāghavaṃ 27
yato dharmas tato rājan_ kuru dharmavinirṇāayaṃ 28
nāsmād bhūyas tato dharmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ yat pradīyate 29

vara
m ekasya bhītasyabhītasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ alaṃkṛtaḥ 30

abha
yaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ
tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit 31

hemadhenudharā
dīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi
durlabhāḥ puruṣā loke sarvabhūtābhayapradāḥ 32

mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālebha
kṣīyate phalam
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya eva na vidyate 33
dattiam iṣṭam tapas taptaṃ tīrthasevā tathā śrutaṃ

sa
rvāṇyabhayadānasya kalpāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ 34
catuḥsāgaraparyyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt prathivīm imāṃ

abhayaṃ sa
rvabhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ 35
api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustyajaṃ

na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ
tyaje dīnakapotakaṃ 36
yan mamāstī śubhaṃ karma tena janmani janmani

bhaveyam ahām ārttānāṃ prāṇinām artthināśa
kaḥ 37
na hi ahaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na svargāṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ

prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ
38
yathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudāhṛtā
satyena tena bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvataraḥ 39

āhārā
rthaṃ samāraṃbhas tava cāhe vihaṃgama
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyad eva dāadāmy ahaṃ 40

ya eva vihi
to smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ
tam evotsṛja nāhāraiḥ kāryyam anyair janeśvaraḥ 41

śyenaāḥ kapotā
n khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī
mā rājan_ śāstram ajñātvā kadalīstaṃbham āruha |
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvavid vertte vihaṃgama

śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ
dharmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ 43
sarvasatveṣu yo dātā ekasatve tu yā dayā

sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaivaikā vi
śiṣyate 44
sarve vedā na tat kuryyuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara

sarvatīrthībhiṣekāś ca yat kuryyāt prāṇināṃ dayā
45
vāṅmanaḥkarmabhir ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
dayā darśitapaṃthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te ||

l.add: gachatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā |

lg.l: yaṃ na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva jīvanaṃ 47

jaṃgamāni
ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ
ātmānam iva rakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ 48

prāṇināṃ vadhya
mānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ 49

rājyaṃ samastaṃ
sumahat_ prayachāmi tava dvija
yad vā kāmayaṣye tv anyad verjayitvā kapotakaṃ 50

ya
di rājan_ kapote te sudaḍhā prītir īdṛśī
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni praghacha me 51
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhibhāṣase
etat te haṃ pradāsyāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāviad ichasi 52
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā
dhruvaṃ nārjjate dharmaṃ sa śocyo muḍhacetanaḥ 53

yadi prāṇyupa
kārāya deho yaṃ nopapadyate
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā 54

nātiriktam ahaṃ
yāceta tava māṃsaṃ janeśvara
tasmāt kapotena samaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtaṃ 55

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi
yan māṃśyenābhibhāṣase
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tathā tava chivihaṃgama 56

evam uktvaḥ sva
māṃsāni samukṛtya sa pārthivaḥ
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ

tyaktvātmasukhalobhe
kṣā sarvasatvahite ratāḥ
dhubhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ 58

dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā ka
poto vyatiricyate
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ 59

na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena sa
maṃ kvacit
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso yam ārurohe svayaṃ tulāṃ 6

paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sa
rvabhūtahite ratā
nāpekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api 61

āatha tatra samārūḍhe tulām auśīna
re nṛpe
devaduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca 63
tatas tasya tadā matvā devarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ
śakrasvarūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata 63

iṃdro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavā
hanaḥ
jijñāsamānau tvā rājann imaṃ yajñam upāgatau 64
naitat pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare

mahā
kāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tvayā 65
parārthe tyajataḥ prāṇān yā prītir abhavat tava

prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāṇesu dehi
nāṃ 66

tvaṃ jaga duḥkhamokṣārthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇāyā nṛpaḥ
67
tathā sarvātmanā vāpi doṣeṣu praharaṃ tvayā
yathā caivātmnaḥ sthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate 68

a
kṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān naivāvamanya ca
akṛtvā sadṛśaiḥ sparddhatvaṃ tal lokottamaṃ gāataḥ 69

paro
pakārajanmāno vidhātrā vihitāś ca te
sajalā jaladās tvaṃ ca saphalāś ca mahādrumāḥ 70

ā
tmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati
sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma yato nāvarttata punaḥ 71

prāṇai
r api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ
svamāṃsāny api dattāni vastuṣv anyeṣu kā kathā 72
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ
paraṃ sa jīvati naro yaḥ parārthāya jīvati 73
kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ

na hi svadehasya śaityāya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ
74
paropakāravyāpāra jāgaraḥ puruṣaḥ sadā

sa padaṃ tām avāpnoti parād api hi yat para
m 75
paropakārasaddharmāḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ

jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sā
dhavas tvadṛśā bhuvi 76
yat svamāṃsānini gātrebhyaḥ samutkṛttāni pārthiva

eṣā te
śāśvatī kīrttir lokānupagamiṣyati 77
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayītvā ciraṃ mahīṃ ||

sarvalokā
n atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi 78

evam uktvā tam iṃdrāgnī jagmutus tridaśā
layaṃ
rājā tu kra|tum iṣṭvā tu mumude devavac ciraṃ 79
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivaṃ naraḥ |

vicitya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sa
rvasya janasya durllabhaṃ
śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau 81

itihāsa
